pages.text: “A cool sensation glides down the throat, filling the air with its crisp fragrance—its leaves dancing with the wind, brimming with life.”$(br2)Mint is a fast-growing, highly resilient herb, renowned for its distinct cooling aroma. Whether used for brewing tea, flavoring food, or as a medicinal herb, mint has a wide range of applications.

Mint is highly adaptable, thriving especially in moist environments. Travelers can find wild mint growing along riverbanks and swamps, and by collecting its seeds, they can cultivate it for easy harvesting.

When harvested, mint plants drop fresh mint leaves along with a small number of mint seeds.$(br)Due to its short growth cycle, mint is ideal for large-scale farming and can be harvested multiple times—an essential companion for refreshing journeys.
